name: product-eval
description: Evidence-gated product decisions that start by scoping product context, evidence sources, and the desired deliverable before ranking opportunities, deciding on bets, pressure-testing plans, or writing outputs.

interface.longDescription: Set up product context and evidence sources, then rank opportunities, decide whether one bet is ready, pressure-test plans, and write briefs, build briefs, or scorecards from scoped product evidence.
defaultPrompt: Set up product-eval for my product.
Help me decide what to build next.
Help me prepare a decision report.
